main_text.p: stris distinctam, jam ritè instru- ctam & comparatam: hanc ego vobis Coronidem, qua par est reverentiâ, cominùs inspicien- dam & examinandam offero, submitto. Si quid in opere (nam in materia nihil: fidem meam interpono: tota solida est & proba) mutandum duxe- ritis, jubete pro jure vestro (Ædiles mei estis) Meum erit exequi quod jubebitis. Sicubi verò cælaturæ nostræ pampinos & corymbos inau- randos esse constituëritis, ef- ficiam profecto, ut in munifi- centia vestra magis eluceat ars mea, & in arte mea splen- deat æternùm munificentia ve- stra. Valete: Bonis & inge- nuis hominibus favete: Ita Deus faveat vobis, Reipubli- cæ vestræ Literariæ, & Summæ Rei.
main_text.notes: Text is set in roman type with italic Ædiles and Latin abbreviations as printed; the first word "stris" is a fragment, the first line begins mid-word (distinctam, the top of the page is cut). The last line "Rei." may be the start of the catchword or the next word; it is read here as part of the text. The line "A 4 · Rei." is printed at the foot; the signature "A 4" has been separated from "Rei.".
